::: {#sol-backward-n-gram-conditional-entropy}

To shorten the displays,
write $p(x_a, \ldots, x_b)$ for $\P(X_a = x_a, \ldots, X_b = x_b)$.
Each value's subscript says which variable takes it.

The reasoning of @sol-forward-n-gram-conditional-entropy carries over,
with the later variables in place of the earlier ones
and @exr-reversed-n-gram-model in place of the [$N$-gram model](#def-n-gram-model):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{X_t \mid X_{t+1}, \ldots, X_n}
&= \sum_{x_{t+1}, \ldots, x_n} p(x_{t+1}, \ldots, x_n) \, \entropyf{X_t \mid X_{t+1} = x_{t+1}, \ldots, X_n = x_n} \\
&= \sum_{x_{t+1}, \ldots, x_n} p(x_{t+1}, \ldots, x_n) \, \entropyf{X_t \mid X_{t+1} = x_{t+1}, \ldots, X_{t+N-1} = x_{t+N-1}} \\
&= \sum_{x_{t+1}, \ldots, x_{t+N-1}} p(x_{t+1}, \ldots, x_{t+N-1}) \, \entropyf{X_t \mid X_{t+1} = x_{t+1}, \ldots, X_{t+N-1} = x_{t+N-1}} \\
&= \entropyf{X_t \mid X_{t+1}, \ldots, X_{t+N-1}}.
\end{aligned}
$$

The first and fourth lines are @thm-conditional-entropy-average.
The second line uses @exr-reversed-n-gram-model and @def-entropy-given-value.
The third line sums over $x_{t+N}, \ldots, x_n$ first,
which gives the [marginal](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-marginal) $p(x_{t+1}, \ldots, x_{t+N-1})$.

The [chain rule](#thm-entropy-chain-rule), with $(X_{t+1}, \ldots, X_{t+N-1})$ as its first variable,
then gives

$$
\entropyf{X_t \mid X_{t+1}, \ldots, X_{t+N-1}}
= \entropyf{X_t, \ldots, X_{t+N-1}} - \entropyf{X_{t+1}, \ldots, X_{t+N-1}}.
$$

The [stationary sequence](#def-stationary-sequence) with shift $s = t - 1$ gives
$(X_t, \ldots, X_{t+N-1})$ the same [joint probability mass function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-joint-pmf) as $(X_1, \ldots, X_N)$,
and with shift $s = t$ it gives $(X_{t+1}, \ldots, X_{t+N-1})$ the same one as $(X_1, \ldots, X_{N-1})$.
So

$$
\entropyf{X_t \mid X_{t+1}, \ldots, X_n}
= \entropyf{X_1, \ldots, X_N} - \entropyf{X_1, \ldots, X_{N-1}}.
$$

:::
